characters.prompt: Create ONE single photorealistic cinematic film still in 16:9 widescreen — one frame only, NOT a grid, no panels, no borders, no captions. INSERT SHOT — NO FACE: this frame contains ONLY the hands, object or body part described below; NO face, NO head, NO eyes, NO full body anywhere in the frame; the frame is cut at the wrist or forearm; the camera is within one metre of the subject. The hand is a FAT man's hand with thick fingers wearing a CHUNKY GOLD METAL BRACELET WATCH (no leather strap), a navy suit cuff and white shirt cuff; the champagne bottle has a completely BLANK dark label with no printing; foam runs over the rim of the flute. IDENTITY FIRST: the person is EXACTLY the one in reference image 1 — same face shape, jaw, cheekbones, nose, eyes, eyebrows, skin tone, age, hairstyle and eyewear; only the expression, lighting and framing described below change. SETTING: the place is reference image 1 ONLY; the background, furniture, lamps and lighting of reference image 1 must NOT appear. Reference image 1 is the location reference: match its architecture, colours, set dressing and light direction; ignore any borders or labels. Photorealistic live-action Japanese corporate drama, Arri Alexa cinematic color grade, Kodak 35mm film grain, 24fps, 16:9, mid-size Tokyo trading company mise-en-scene, no flat lighting. High angle extreme close-up: a champagne flute being filled to overflowing by a fat hand with a gold wristwatch, foam running over. No person's face is visible. Camera: high-angle looking down, 100mm macro lens, f/2.8, very shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, the subject fills more than 70 percent of the frame. Lighting: cold even fluorescent ceiling light 5600K from directly above, faint cool cast, soft shadows under the brow. Only the people described (1 named), no extra sharp faces.  All papers, screens, signs, banners, box labels and plates are completely blank; no letters, numbers or symbols anywhere in the frame. Negative: gibberish, foreign text, incomprehensible letters, fake alphabets, blurry typography, text on badge, text on name tag, logo on shirt, brand logos, lapel pin, company badge, signage lettering, posters with writing, printed labels, watermarks, stamps, symbols on collar, bad anatomy, deformed eyes, extra fingers, extra arms, duplicate people. Open-plan office: monitors show only a blank blue-grey glow, every paper, binder spine, partition label and whiteboard is completely blank; no posters with writing. Full-frame 16:9 image filling the whole canvas: NO black bars, NO white borders, NO letterbox or pillarbox. The figure is a true backlit silhouette: no facial features readable, only outline, hair shape and body mass. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or symbols anywhere in the image.
